# target_ct bytes from 0x402060
target_ct = bytes([0xe7, 0xab, 0x72, 0x33, 0xc0, 0x5b, 0xc6, 0x69, 
                   0x0d, 0xa2, 0x4b, 0xec, 0x65, 0xe0, 0x9e, 0x32,
                   0xa5, 0x4e, 0xef, 0x3d, 0x75, 0x44, 0x96, 0xab])

# Algorithm from seal_block:
# edx starts at 0xffffffa1, but only low 8 bits matter for XOR with sil
# For each i:
#   input[i] XOR (edx & 0xff) == target_ct[i]
#   So input[i] = target_ct[i] XOR (edx & 0xff)
#   Then edx += input[i]

edx = 0xffffffa1
result = []

for i in range(24):
    # input[i] = target_ct[i] XOR (edx & 0xff)
    input_byte = target_ct[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
    result.append(input_byte)
    # Update edx
    edx = (edx + input_byte) & 0xffffffff

print("Recovered input bytes:", result)
print("As string:", bytes(result))
print("Hex:", bytes(result).hex())
